title: Mannequin Mirror
description: A mirror made using a mannequin.
body:
# Summary
This data pack is mirrored around the 0 Z axis using a mannequin.
Supports held items, armor, and sneaking.
Currently, this only supports single player.
# Installation Guide
Insert this data pack and type:

```
/summon mannequin ~ ~ ~ {Team:"team",profile:"<your name>"}
```

To summon a mannequin that functions as a mirror.
